name: 2026 Advanced Vulnerability Research Flow
description: A professional-grade research chain from reconnaissance to RCE via XSS and poisoning.

recon.label: Network Reconnaissance
recon.description: Identify open ports and services using Nmap.
recon.ai_guidance: Check for open web ports (80, 443, 8080). If found, we move to Web Analysis.

web_analysis.label: Web Surface Mapping
web_analysis.description: Map directories, endpoints, and identify potential injection points.
web_analysis.ai_guidance: Look for search bars, contact forms, or URL parameters that reflect input.

xss_discovery.label: XSS Hunting
xss_discovery.description: Verify if input endpoints are vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting.
xss_discovery.ai_guidance: Test for reflected XSS. If successful, we can use this to hijack sessions or poison the cache.

session_poisoning.label: Session/Cache Poisoning
session_poisoning.description: Use XSS or header manipulation to poison the session or server cache.
session_poisoning.ai_guidance: Now that we have XSS, we target the admin session or attempt to poison the HTTP cache to redirect users.

privilege_escalation.label: Privilege Escalation & Upload
privilege_escalation.description: Use the hijacked session to find administrative upload functionality.
privilege_escalation.ai_guidance: Search for file upload fields in the admin panel. Try to upload a web shell.

rce_final.label: Remote Code Execution
rce_final.description: Trigger the uploaded shell to gain full system access.
rce_final.ai_guidance: Execute the shell. We have successfully achieved RCE on the target.

network_pivot.label: Internal Pivot
network_pivot.ai_guidance: No web ports found. Pivot to scanning for common management services.

exploit_service.label: Service Exploitation
exploit_service.description: Use Metasploit or specialized tools to exploit the discovered service.
exploit_service.ai_guidance: Matching the service version against known exploits in Metasploit.
